translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: YOHANE
book.title: Yohane Yeng Yesuac Siduc Gombung Ohoec

content: Hanac hanaheaunacngoc enacyoacngo kefec nga enacyoac ye Anutugoc kefec amma enacyoac ye Anutu.
Amma yennoc hanac hanaheau Anutugoc kefec.
Nga Anutungo enacyoacfu deu wiac sasawa fingecdarec, wiac sasawa fingecma fekende imoc yea kpac mong mi fingerec.
Yearunoc kekec feec nga kekec imocngo ngicngac yeneac kperagi anec.
Nga kperagingo kundung mekperagiu kundungngo kperagi imoc semeudeac ambibiema waec.
Anutungo ngic mong sueu haec, yeac kpara Yohane.
Yeng kperagi imocac hepucngic amma dedekperagi imoc ngicngac mekperagiyemmeudeac haec. Yeng ifi hau ngicngac sasawango kperagia imoc negensinggegecdeac negenec.
Ye yengenaoc kperagi imoc mi kefec, kpac. Ye ine kperagi imoc mekperagiudeac haec.
Anu kperagi fora yombong, yeng bangecfu ngicngac sasawa mekperagiyemmebeso haudeac anec.
Anutu ye kperagiango bangec nga wiac sasawa meficgedaru kperagia imocngo bangecfu kefu ngicngac yeneng ine ye mi hensigec.
Ye bangehau dzigenemanu arengfora yeneng ama mi heimigec.
Nga ngicngac ama heimima kpara negensinggegec, yeni Anutuac nambaracfora anggecdeac deyemmeec.
Deyemmeu ngicngac imoc yeni ngic sacfusiunac me sebiac songounac me ngic monggac songounac mong mi fingecgec, kpac. Yeni Anutu yengenaarunac fingecgec.

Anu enacyoacngo sebifusiagoc amma botucninau kefec. Kefu medac mocgungo fingecma Manggacarunac kuc nga kibikperagia mekefec, kuc nga kibikperagia imocnoc hening. Henni yearu danggunuc nga yoac fora wake wakea fede.
Yohanengo yeac hepuc amma dekperagima kpacma yofi deec, “Ni yeacnoc yofi deai, ngadenau hama kecde, ye kunenna, nocac ni mi fingecbarengoc ye kechakefec.”
Dedeseriyoacngo Mosegoc hau yearunac meing nga danggunuc amma yoac fora imoc Yesu Kristogoc haec. Amma ye danggunuc hafoangoc femide, imocngo nenannu wisic wisickea kpac hakecde.
Ngic mongngo Anutu mong mi henec, kpac. Medaha mocgusac Mamaac hoannu kecande, ye Anutungoc. Yeng Manggac dekperaginemmeec.

Yudangic Yerusareng taonnu kecgec, yeneng womong gareng nga womong gareng yeneac memefic sueyunugec Yohanearu kemma kpesimigec, “Ge merac?” kpesimigec, yeng haniaya mi hesonggema yofi dekperagiyemmeec, “Ni Messia kpac.” imocngo Yohaneac dedekperagi.
Ifi deu yeneng monggoc kpesimigec, “Ge merac, ge Eria me?” kpesimigec yeng deec, “Ni ye kpac.” deu degec, “Ge profete yombong me?” degec merenec, “Kpac.”
Ifi deu degec, “Anu ge merac? Suenunudau, yenearu yoac turunga dafi mekemma edeyununide? Ge geanggaac dafi deannec?”
Ifi degec Yohanengo yofi merenec,

content.text: “Bangec kisiu ubaudumeng fingerec imoc nennoc yofi kpacduae, ‘Ngeni KEBUAC sing heitumeigec.’ (Yesaia 40:3)

content: Profete Yesaiango neac ifi deec.”
Anu farisaio yeneng ngic goa sueyunugec kemma
Yohane kpesimigec, “Ge Messia kpac nga Eria kpac amma profete kpac. Ge nocac ngic doku nadzicyemmeannec?”
Ifi degec Yohanengo yofi merengyemmeec, “Ni doku nadzicngemmeanduae. Nga botucnginau ngic mong kecde, ngeni ye mi negemmidae.
Yeng ngadenau hama kecde nga ni ifiango yeac hanitabe witiha yungecba naric mi ngereeude.”
Yohanengo Betania amau Yordang doku nobocgengau doku nadzicyemmekefec, imohai faka imoc fingerec.
Wereckengau Yohanengo namma henu Yesungo yearu hau ngicngac yofi edeyunuec, “Henggec, imoc Anutuac ramamedaha, yeng bangectoa bangec imocac ngicngac sasawa yeneac kopocsic meickeude.”
Yeacnoc negemma yofi deai, “Ngic mong ngadenau hama kecde, yeng ni mi fingecbare bicngoc yombong kefecac ni feracnude.
Neng ye mi negemmiai. Nga israengicngac ngeneng ye hentegecgecdeac neng hama doku nadzicngemmebade.”
Yohanengo yofi dekperagiec, “Ni Tiri Asu hemba yeng kebesacac siric isoc kurumennunac mama yeac witiau taru henai.
Nga ni ye mi negemmibare suenuec, yeng yofi edenuec, ‘Asungo mama ngic yearu taru hennade, yeng Tiri Asungo nadzicngemmeude.’
Ni imocnoc hemma hepuc amma yofi dekperagiai, ngic yomocngo Anutuac medac.”
Anu wereckengau Yohane ye medacfora yenearunac yohockang yerigoc imohai monggoc nanggec.
Nammagec Yesungo kenu hemma medahora yofi edeyuruec, “Henec, imoc Anutuac ramamedaha.”
Ifi deu negemma medahora yereng Yesu modacma kenec Yesungo dzigene yeremma yofi kpesiyemerec, “Ngeri noc wiacac angecmede?” kpesiyemeru deoc, “Rabbi, (imocac titiha kpoukpou) ge dahai kecnec?”
Deec yofi edeyuruec, “Ngeri hama henec.” ifi deu yeni yenahafoc kemma ama kefec, imoc hemma wenac imoc yegoc taroc. Faka yomoc marai 4 kiroc fingerec.
Anu Yohaneac yoac negemma Yesu modaroc, yerearunac mong Anderea, Simong Petoroac munea.
Yeng Yesu hemma dzigenema warac warac yengena munea Simong meficgema yofi edeec, “Neri Messia meficgedic.” (Messia imocac titiha Kristo.)
Ifi dema Simong hesickeu Yesuaru kenec Yesungo ye hemma yofi deec, “Ge Simong Yohaneac medac, geac kpacga Kefa debesonga.” (Imocac titiha hoc amma grikyoacfu Petros.)
Wereckengau Yesungo Gariraia bangecfu kembesonga negemma Firipo meficgema yofi edeec, “Ge hama modacnuna.”
Nga Firipo nga Anderea amma Petoro yeni Besaida taonnunac.
Anu Firipongo Natanae meficgema yofi edeec, “Mosengo dedeseriyoac kibiu ohoec nga profete yeneng ifingoc ohogec, neni ngic imoc meficgeding. Imoc Yesunoc, Yosefeac medac, Nadzarete taonnunac.”
Ifi deu Natanaengo deec, “Nadzarete taonnunac wiac gombunga mong mi fingecande.” ifi deu Firipongo deec, “Ge hama henna.”
Nga Yesungo Natanae henu yearu kenu yofi deec, “Henggec, ngic yomoc israengic fora, yearu ikoc nga faitobang faka mong mi fede.”
Ifi deu Natanaengo kpesimiec, “Ge dafi negennunec?” Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Firipongo mi kpacgumanu fig ic haniau tacmana bic gendua.”
Ifi deu Natanaengo yofi edeec, “Rabbi, ge Anutuac medac, Israe neneac Ngictau.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi meremmiec, “Ge fig ic haniau tacna gendua deduaeac negensinnunec. Kecma faka yofia monggoc ferahema fingeru hennade.
Negenggec, kurumeng anggeu ngeni Anutuac angerofora yeneng Ngicac Medac yearu engemmama anggec yenenggecde, imoc fora yombong edengunuduae.”

footnotes.text: Betania ama yohockang feoc. Mong Yerusareng wegena nga mong Yordang wegena.
